thread:
elaine_sales: Heads up — Bank PLC RFP: they want an air-gapped POC. Key asks: offline delta updates via USB, signed SBOM, HSM-backed key rotation, absolutely no outbound telemetry, and a 6mo pilot SOW. Can eng confirm feasibility + ops constraints?

matt_engineer: Short answer: feasible but with caveats. Offline deltas need a deterministic layering tool and a robust apply/revert flow. GPU driver diffs kill small delta sizes — we'll need their exact hardware/driver baseline.

sophie_se: We can produce signed delta tarballs (sha256). Practical delta size depends on model quantization + driver differences; estimate ~200–300MB typical, but could be multiple GB if drivers change. Also need clarity on how often they expect model updates.

ron_security: Telemetry disabled is fine. We require image attestation and chain-of-custody for signed SBOMs. HSM support only via PKCS#11; need vendor + firmware versions. If they want customer-managed keys, we need an onboarding key exchange process.

elaine_sales: They want the security questionnaire filled by EOW and are asking about upgrade cadence: 2-week hotfix path + quarterly feature updates. Also asked for pricing estimate for pilot + support retainer.

amy_legal: Note: offline redistribution needs an explicit redistrib clause in the license + indemnity points. Sales, pls collect full customer legal entity and SOC2/ISO gaps before we sign SOW.

matt_engineer: Ops notes: offline activation options — one-time activation token (good for pilot) or host-locked license for long-term. Emergency hotfixes are doable but outside base support unless we include a retainer. We'll need an agreed maintenance window and an offline patch apply tool we ship.

elaine_sales: Can you give ballparks? Customer expects numbers soon. They asked for 6mo pilot, two on-call engs during cutover, 48h hotfix SLA.

sophie_se: Ballpark figures for RFP response: pilot license $25k, support retainer $12k/month for two engineers (up to 48h/month, additional hours billed), per-hotfix fee $4k if outside retainer. Engineering: automation + test harness for delta delivery ~2w effort.

ron_security: :thumbsup: We'll run a short threat model. Client wants proof we sign SBOMs with a key they can verify; prefer to use their HSM for signing. Need to schedule key-exchange + PKI validation.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: checklist created -> https://internal/tasks/PROJ-4215 (includes: SBOM signing flow, offline apply guide, activation token flow, rollback test cases).

elaine_sales: Perfect. Last asks before I send RFP response: can eng provide a deterministic checksum command we can hand to client, and a short SOW bullet list covering acceptance tests, rollback, on-call windows, and upgrade cadence?

matt_engineer: Use this to verify: `sha256sum redwood-image.tar.gz` (send checksum to client). SOW bullets: acceptance test (baseline infer smoke + perf), rollback plan (apply previous image + clear KV cache), signing/verification procedure, on-call coverage hours, upgrade cadence (hotfix/quarterly), emergency patch SLA.

elaine_sales: Thanks all — I'll draft the RFP response with these numbers and send for legal/security review before EOW.
notes: Thread follows presales -> eng -> security -> legal -> ops bot flow for air-gapped POC feasibility and commercial ballpark. Kept concise per Slack style.
